summary: Nuxt page component for the desktop route `lang-company-terms2` (layout `empty`), the secondary terms page (terms2). In `asyncData` it calls the CMS content API (module 1118) `getTerms2`, which fetches the `/getContentList` entry for channel `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.PROTOCOL.TERMS2`, passing `sLangKey: store.state.lang`; when nothing is returned it redirects to `lang-main` (with `params.lang = store.state.lang`), otherwise it exposes `title`, `content` and `pdfUrl` (from `sTitle`/`sContent`/`pdfUrl`) as page data. `head()` sets the document title to the entry title plus the i18n `seoTitlePrefix`. The render function shows, inside `client-only`, either a `protocol-pdf` (HoYoverse PDF viewer, module 1131, with `is-mob` = false and `pdf-url`) when `pdfUrl` is set, or the `protocol` text component (desktop protocol, module 1142) with `title`/`content`.

exports.default: the `lang-company-terms2` desktop secondary terms page (terms2) Vue component (compiled with vue-loader normalizer)
